text: Steinberg's tensor product theorem describes every irreducible module of a reductive algebraic group in characteristic $p$ as:
choices: a direct sum of Verma modules
induced from a single Borel character
a tensor product of Frobenius twists of restricted representations
explanation: Steinberg's theorem: in characteristic $p$ every irreducible $G$-module is a tensor product of Frobenius twists of restricted representations. Such modules are generally not one-dimensional, are not built from (infinite-dimensional) Verma modules, and are not merely induced Borel characters, which would instead describe principal series.
